Subject: Contractor payee setup — legal name, remittance & PO routing

Hi Sam,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard with Redwood for the upcoming integration work. To get you into our vendor/payee system and ensure POs and invoices route correctly, could you confirm the following and attach any standard onboarding docs you have (W-9 or local tax form, bank details stub for ACH)?

Requested items:
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on our vendor record
- Entity type (LLC, Corp, Sole Proprietor, etc.)
- Tax ID / EIN (last 4 digits are fine to start if you prefer security)
- Registered address (legal and remit if different)
- Invoice contact name, email, and preferred invoice delivery (email/portal/EDI)
- Preferred payment method (ACH/wire/check) and any instructions (we'll redact account numbers in our systems)
- Any required vendor documents: W-9 (US), VAT reg docs (EU), or equivalent

Target: if we receive these by EOD Thursday, we can create the payee record and send a PO next week. If you have a preferred PO contact or a billing email different from your account rep, include that too.

Thanks —
Chloe
Chloe Martin
